2. Craft coal into quartz blocks (gather 8 coal, create 4 quartz blocks).
3. Craft quartz slabs (use 2 quartz blocks to make 1 slab, repeat until 2 slabs are crafted).
4. Combine 2 slabs to create 1 chiseled quartz block.

This completes the process for crafting a chiseled quartz block.
